rationale.complete: Two light exploratory rounds with predictions written first and reusable observable tables built, but no scorecard, no goal-period verdicts, no held-out estimator and no confirmatory run.
rationale.faithfulness: Some predictions beat their nulls (regime-I kick hazard, the consolidation cycle, timer-set pauses), but several were refuted and the thermodynamic constructs themselves (landscapes, Kramers barriers, equation of state) mostly reduce to schedule fields or scaffold mechanics.
rationale.usefulness: Round 1b: an operator rule with ledger evidence (address a paused agent; chatter alone keeps it asleep, OR 0.50 vs 3.1 for mentions), stable across drive withdrawal (NE43); memory set point independent of read inflow.

one_line: Thermo framing adds little; the timer gate reads context (chatter holds, @-mentions release); memory is an overshooting homeostat
rated_by: RE-R1 agent (suggested, round 1b); coordinator calibration pending

v2.claim: Agents leave idle at a timer gate; unaddressed chatter holds them there (OR 0.50) and a mention releases them (OR 3.1); memory size is a set point that overshoots after erasure
v2.scope: regime III gate test; NE43; #51 roster sweep

ladder.factor: intervention consistent (NE43 gate unchanged; erasure overshoot)
penalty: chatter effect opposite to own prediction (post hoc reading)

v2.decision: release stuck agents by naming them, not by broadcasting
v2.rater: coordinator, updated after round 1b (RE-R1); independent rater pending

v2_history.claim: Idle agents are timer-gated; memory size is a set point
v2_history.rater: coordinator first pass (from integrated reports); independent rater pending
